question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared `@openclaw/localization-core` and process-selected CLI presentation contract as the approved foundation for the linked five-PR localization series?
rationale: The branch establishes a cross-surface internal package, expands locale-selected behavior into established CLI operations, and is intentionally sequenced behind an open foundation PR; code review alone cannot choose the permanent product and ownership boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the staged runtime contract
options.body: Approve the shared runtime direction and review the five PRs in the declared dependency order, requiring focused upgrade and behavior proof before each merge.

options.title: Narrow to existing surface-owned i18n
options.body: Keep localization within the current CLI, wizard, and Control UI owners and ask for a smaller proposal that avoids a new shared runtime package.

options.title: Pause the series for RFC resolution
options.body: Leave the drafts open but defer implementation until the linked RFC has a maintainer-approved scope and ownership decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged runtime contract
recommendation.body: Approve the shared runtime direction and review the five PRs in the declared dependency order, requiring focused upgrade and behavior proof before each merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this account as the author of the connected localization design and implementation series; a repository owner should make the final sponsorship decision.
